title: A股港股早报：腾讯AI投入压利润，存储与AI基建映射接力 + 美股盘前：PPI降温托底，AI硬件遭高预期筛选
summary: 腾讯8月12日晚公布二季度业绩，收入同比增长11%、Non-IFRS归母净利同比增长9%，但IFRS归母净利仅增0.7%、AI资本开支同比增长176%并形成负自由现金流；隔夜美股AI云、服务器、存储、光通信继续强于软件，A/H关注腾讯、CPO/光模块、AI服务器、存储和能源防御的开盘验证。 7月PPI环比持平、同比降至4.7%，期指小幅偏强但纳指不再单边领涨；Cisco、Cerebras、Coherent和StubHub显示“业绩好也可能被卖”，盘前更适合关注Netflix、NVIDIA、Ondas、Garmin等有正反馈或承接的标的，今晚核心科技财报样本集中在Applied Materials (AMAT)。

Overnight US trading favored AI cloud, servers, storage and optical links over software. A/H focus: Tencent, CPO/optics, AI servers, storage and energy defense.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东航运与油价风险仍是早盘估值上限
8月12日公开报道显示，红海、曼德海峡和霍尔木兹相关安全事件继续抬高能源安全溢价，IEA也提示全球油品库存快速消耗；A/H 映射到中海油、中国石油、油服、航运成本和通胀交易。
国际
美国通胀符合预期后纳指小涨，美债仍限制高估值扩张
AP 报道8月12日标普500涨0.3%、纳指涨0.5%、道指微跌，10年期美债在4.68%附近；风险偏好修复但不是全面降息交易，恒生科技和A股成长仍需看成交与美元/离岸人民币方向。
科技
隔夜 Sparks 显示存储与英伟达持仓链领涨
Futunn Sparks 正数 Top5 为存储概念 +6.72%（SKHY +9.01%）、英伟达持仓概念 +6.58%（NBIS +34.14%）、太空概念 +6.09%（ATRO +17.33%）、加密矿企 +4.42%（CANG +27.33%）、OLED 概念 +4.19%（AMAT +4.29%）；A/H 映射优先看存储、算力服务器、CPO/OLED材料与半导体设备。
科技
AI云与服务器财报强反馈继续支撑硬件链
公开报道显示 Nebius 因二季度收入与EBITDA超预期大涨约34%，CoreWeave 与 Super Micro 均涨约19%；这强化 GPU 租赁、AI服务器、液冷、电源、PCB 和光互连需求，A/H 映射工业富联、浪潮信息、中际旭创、新易盛、沪电股份等。
科技
软件股相对承压，AI交易从应用端回到基建端
Barron's 报道 Palantir 跌约2.2%、Microsoft 跌约2.3%，Salesforce、ServiceNow、Workday等软件股也走弱；这说明隔夜资金更偏向芯片、云算力、服务器和光通信，A/H 软件与SaaS只适合等待价格确认。
科技
光通信与半导体精选仍有延伸，但高位需要量能验证
Sparks 中光通信 +1.76%（LITE +13.63%）、半导体精选 +2.27%（MU +4.92%），与AI基建财报形成同向验证；A/H CPO、存储和设备股若高开后缩量回落，应视为卖事实而非突破。
财报
腾讯二季度收入增11%，AI投入压低利润与现金流
腾讯官方8月12日晚公布2Q2026：收入2047.85亿元、同比增11%，Non-IFRS归母净利684.15亿元、同比增9%；IFRS归母净利560.22亿元、同比仅增0.7%，资本开支527.84亿元、同比增176%，自由现金流为负138亿元。基本面韧性与AI投入并存，今日0700.HK开盘价格反应是恒生科技核心验证。
财报
可验证 A/H 权重财报主要集中在腾讯
本机 Futu OpenD 127.0.0.1:11111 拒绝连接，HK/SH/SZ earnings calendar 与 NOTICE 子项受限；公开来源确认腾讯为昨晚最重要A/H/HSTECH权重财报，未确认阿里、美团、小米、中芯国际、华虹等同窗口正式业绩结果，因此不使用美股公司财报补位。

盘前结论

今日最强正反馈来自隔夜 AI 基建链：存储、英伟达持仓、AI云、服务器、光通信和半导体设备同时获得价格或财报验证。但软件股走弱和油价风险说明风险偏好并非全面扩张，高估值成长需要成交量确认。

腾讯财报是恒生科技的核心变量：收入、游戏、广告和云服务仍有韧性，但AI资本开支与负自由现金流会压制利润率叙事，0700.HK若低开后承接，才可带动平台互联网修复。

Futu OpenD 未启动导致本地日历和公告子检查受限，已按规则降级；盘中仍需补看交易所公告和南向资金，避免把美股财报当作A/H财报结果。

重点个股推荐

腾讯控股
0700.HK
财报验证

推荐理由：腾讯是今日最重要HSTECH权重财报，收入、游戏、广告和云服务仍有韧性，能直接影响恒生科技情绪。

触发因素：2Q收入同比增11%、Non-IFRS归母净利同比增9%，同时AI产品和云需求带来长期叙事。

风险点：IFRS归母净利仅增0.7%、capex同比增176%且自由现金流为负，若开盘放量走弱，应降级为观察而非追多。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO映射

推荐理由：AI基建财报和光通信Sparks同向，CPO仍是A股对美股AI硬件最直接的映射。

触发因素：LITE +13.63%、光通信 +1.76%，叠加CRWV/SMCI/NBIS强反馈。

风险点：板块已处高位，若高开缩量或龙头冲高回落，容易触发卖事实。

工业富联
601138.SH
服务器链

推荐理由：AI云、服务器和英伟达持仓链同时领涨，服务器制造、液冷、电源和PCB有望获得映射。

触发因素：NBIS +34.14%、CRWV和SMCI均约+19%，验证AI资本开支仍在硬件端兑现。

风险点：如果A股算力硬件高开后成交不能放大，说明资金只做隔夜映射而非趋势扩散。

兆易创新
603986.SH
存储最强

推荐理由：Sparks存储概念 +6.72% 是隔夜最强映射，A股存储芯片和模组链具备开盘弹性。

触发因素：SKHY +9.01%、MU +4.92%，AI服务器需求强化存储价格和库存周期预期。

风险点：若存储价格、订单和业绩没有同步验证，主题可能从强映射变成短线兑现。

中国海洋石油
0883.HK
能源对冲

推荐理由：中东航运与油价风险仍高，能源高股息可对冲科技高估值波动。

触发因素：IEA库存警示、红海和霍尔木兹安全事件、油价风险溢价。

风险点：若油价快速回落或谈判缓和，能源股可能从防御转为高开回吐。

板块轮动看板

受益方向存储、AI服务器、CPO光通信、OLED材料、半导体设备、能源高股息。
观察方向腾讯与平台互联网、港股云服务、低空/太空概念、加密金融情绪映射。
压力方向软件/SaaS、高估值消费成长、家居零售、缺乏业绩兑现的主题股。
验证信号0700.HK开盘承接、恒生科技成交额、CPO龙头放量、SOXX/SMH相对纳指强弱、油价亚洲盘。

逻辑链

美国CPI符合预期带来风险修复，但美债和油价仍限制A/H高估值成长的估值扩张。
隔夜Sparks和公开报道显示AI交易集中到存储、云算力、服务器、光通信和半导体设备。
腾讯财报提供本地权重验证：核心收入韧性支撑平台情绪，AI投入和现金流压力限制单边乐观。
软件股承压说明AI应用端估值被重新审视，A/H软件和SaaS应弱于硬件映射链。
若腾讯和CPO/存储龙头同时放量承接，恒生科技和A股科技可延续修复；若仅高开无量，则能源防御和低估值方向更稳。

风险雷达

腾讯卖事实

若市场更关注AI capex、负自由现金流和IFRS利润低增长，平台权重可能压制恒生科技。

AI硬件拥挤

NBIS、CRWV、SMCI、LITE涨幅较大，A/H映射股若高开回落，会触发板块兑现。

能源通胀尾险

中东航运事件若继续推高油价，会重新抬升通胀预期和美债收益率。

软件负反馈扩散

美股软件股下跌若延续，港股云服务和A股软件应用可能弱于硬件链。

Futu子项受限

OpenD端口拒绝连接，今日A/H公告日历需盘中继续核验交易所公告。

entries.html_en:
Major News
International
Middle East shipping and oil risk still cap opening valuations
August 12 public reports showed Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb and Hormuz security events continuing to lift the energy-security premium, while the IEA warned that oil-product inventories are being rapidly depleted; A/H mapping runs through CNOOC, PetroChina, oil services, shipping costs and inflation trades.
International
Nasdaq rose after in-line US inflation, but Treasury yields still restrain high multiples
AP reported that on August 12 the S&P 500 rose 0.3%, the Nasdaq gained 0.5%, and the Dow edged lower, with the 10-year Treasury near 4.68%; risk appetite improved, but this is not a broad easing trade, so HSTECH and A-share growth still need turnover plus dollar/offshore-yuan confirmation.
Technology
Overnight Sparks shows storage and Nvidia-holder chains leading
Futunn Sparks positive Top5 were Data Storage +6.72% (SKHY +9.01%), Nvidia Holdings +6.58% (NBIS +34.14%), Space +6.09% (ATRO +17.33%), Crypto Miners +4.42% (CANG +27.33%), and OLED +4.19% (AMAT +4.29%); A/H mapping should prioritize storage, AI servers, CPO/OLED materials and semiconductor equipment.
Technology
Strong AI cloud and server earnings feedback keeps supporting hardware
Public reports showed Nebius rising about 34% after Q2 revenue and EBITDA beat expectations, while CoreWeave and Super Micro each gained about 19%; this reinforces demand for GPU rental, AI servers, liquid cooling, power, PCB and optical interconnects, mapping to FII, Inspur, Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and Wus Printed Circuit.
Technology
Software underperformed as AI trading shifted back to infrastructure
Barron's reported Palantir down about 2.2% and Microsoft down about 2.3%, with Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday also weaker; overnight capital preferred chips, cloud compute, servers and optical links, so A/H software and SaaS should wait for price confirmation.
Technology
Optical links and semiconductors can extend, but high levels need volume
Sparks also showed Optical Communication +1.76% (LITE +13.63%) and Selected Semiconductors +2.27% (MU +4.92%), aligning with AI infrastructure earnings; if A/H CPO, storage and equipment names gap up then fade on light volume, treat it as sell-the-news, not a breakout.
Earnings
Tencent Q2 revenue rose 11%, but AI spending compressed profit and cash flow
Tencent's official August 12 release showed 2Q2026 revenue of RMB204.785 billion, up 11% year on year, and non-IFRS attributable profit of RMB68.415 billion, up 9%; IFRS attributable profit was RMB56.022 billion, up only 0.7%, capex was RMB52.784 billion, up 176%, and free cash flow was negative RMB13.8 billion. Business resilience and AI investment coexist, making 0700.HK's opening reaction the key HSTECH test.
Earnings
Verifiable A/H heavyweight earnings centered on Tencent
Local Futu OpenD refused 127.0.0.1:11111, limiting HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar and NOTICE checks; public sources confirmed Tencent as the main post-close A/H/HSTECH heavyweight result, with no verified same-window formal results from Alibaba, Meituan, Xiaomi, SMIC or Hua Hong, so US-company earnings are not used as A/H earnings filler.

Pre-Market View

The strongest positive feedback today comes from overnight AI infrastructure: storage, Nvidia-holder names, AI cloud, servers, optical links and semiconductor equipment all have price or earnings validation.But weaker software shares and oil risk show risk appetite is not broad-based, so high-multiple growth needs turnover confirmation.

Tencent earnings are the core HSTECH variable: revenue, games, advertising and cloud remain resilient, but AI capex and negative free cash flow pressure the margin story; only a supported 0700.HK open can lift platform-internet repair.

Futu OpenD was not running, limiting local calendar and notice sub-checks, so the run degraded under the rules; exchange notices and southbound flows still need intraday confirmation, and US earnings are not treated as A/H earnings results.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage move.

Focus Stocks

Tencent Holdings
0700.HK
Earnings test

Rationale: Tencent is today's most important HSTECH heavyweight result, and its revenue, games, advertising and cloud resilience can directly affect HSTECH sentiment.

Trigger: Q2 revenue rose 11% year on year and non-IFRS attributable profit rose 9%, while AI products and cloud demand keep the long-term narrative alive.

Risk: IFRS attributable profit rose only 0.7%, capex rose 176%, and free cash flow was negative; if the stock opens weak on volume, downgrade it to watch instead of chasing.

Zhongji Innolight
300308.SZ
CPO mapping

Rationale: AI infrastructure earnings and optical Sparks point in the same direction, leaving CPO as the most direct A-share map to US AI hardware.

Trigger: LITE +13.63% and Optical Communication +1.76%, combined with strong CRWV, SMCI and NBIS feedback.

Risk: The sector is already elevated; a light-volume gap or leader reversal would trigger sell-the-news pressure.

Foxconn Industrial Internet
601138.SH
Server chain

Rationale: AI cloud, servers and Nvidia-holder names all led, giving server manufacturing, liquid cooling, power and PCB a mapping bid.

Trigger: NBIS +34.14%, with CRWV and SMCI each about +19%, validating AI capex through hardware.

Risk: If A-share compute hardware gaps up without expanding turnover, capital is only trading the overnight map, not trend broadening.

GigaDevice
603986.SH
Storage leader

Rationale: Data Storage +6.72% was the strongest overnight mapping lane, giving A-share memory chips and modules opening beta.

Trigger: SKHY +9.01% and MU +4.92%, with AI-server demand strengthening memory-pricing and inventory-cycle expectations.

Risk: If storage pricing, orders and earnings do not confirm, the theme can quickly turn from strong mapping to short-term profit taking.

CNOOC
0883.HK
Energy hedge

Rationale: Middle East shipping and oil risks remain elevated, making high-dividend energy a hedge against high-multiple technology volatility.

Trigger: IEA inventory warnings, Red Sea and Hormuz security events, and crude-risk premium.

Risk: If oil falls quickly or negotiations ease, energy shares can give back defensive gains after a high open.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength to WatchStorage, AI servers, CPO optics, OLED materials, semiconductor equipment and high-dividend energy.
Watch ListTencent and platform internet, Hong Kong cloud services, low-altitude/space themes, and crypto-finance sentiment maps.
PressureSoftware/SaaS, high-multiple consumer growth, home-improvement retail and themes without earnings delivery.
Signals0700.HK opening support, HSTECH turnover, CPO leader volume, SOXX/SMH relative strength versus Nasdaq, and Asia-session crude.

Logic Chain

In-line US CPI supports risk repair, but Treasury yields and oil still restrain valuation expansion for A/H high-multiple growth.
Overnight Sparks and public reports show AI trading concentrated in storage, cloud compute, servers, optical links and semiconductor equipment.
Tencent earnings provide the local heavyweight test: resilient core revenue supports platform sentiment, while AI spending and cash-flow pressure limit one-way optimism.
Software-share weakness shows AI application valuations are being reassessed, so A/H software and SaaS should lag hardware mapping chains.
If Tencent and CPO/storage leaders both hold on volume, HSTECH and A-share technology can extend repair; if the move is only a light-volume gap, energy defense and low valuation are steadier.

Risk Radar

Tencent sell-the-news

If investors focus on AI capex, negative free cash flow and slow IFRS profit growth, the platform heavyweight can weigh on HSTECH.

AI hardware crowding

NBIS, CRWV, SMCI and LITE already moved sharply; if A/H mapping names gap then fade, the sector will face profit taking.

Energy inflation tail

If Middle East shipping events keep lifting crude, inflation expectations and Treasury yields can rise again.

Software feedback spreads

If US software weakness persists, Hong Kong cloud services and A-share software applications may lag hardware chains.

Futu sub-checks limited

OpenD refused the local port, so today's A/H notice calendar still needs intraday exchange-announcement checks.

Sources and Timestamp

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
7月PPI环比持平，批发通胀低于市场预期
公开报道显示，美国7月PPI终值环比持平、同比约4.7%，低于此前预期并较6月5.5%明显降温；核心PPI环比约0.2%，使市场继续押注美联储在9月前获得更多观察时间。
就业
初请失业金约20.9万，软数据没有破坏风险偏好
Investors.com报道初请失业金约20.9万，高于预期但仍不代表就业急速恶化；PPI与就业数据组合支持温和开盘，而不是恐慌式防御。
指数
期指小幅偏强，纳指100略弱于道指和标普
盘前报道显示道指期货约+0.2%、标普500期货约+0.1%，纳指100期货小幅偏弱；说明通胀利好被高估值科技的财报分化部分抵消。
利率
10年期美债约4.66%-4.68%，利率仍是成长股估值上限
10年期美债在PPI后回落到约4.66%-4.68%区间，但绝对水平仍高；对AI硬件可形成托底，对无盈利软件和小盘成长仍是约束。
商品
原油回落、黄金走弱，通胀压力暂时缓和
AP、Investopedia和Barron's盘前报道均提到油价下跌，WTI约81.3-81.5美元，布伦特跌近2%；黄金也小幅走弱，降低了日内通胀尾险但没有消除中东风险。

Cisco (CSCO) beat后仍跌约6%-7%，不能写成多头推荐
Cisco收入和利润好于预期、AI hyperscaler订单仍有支撑，但盘前下跌约6%-7%，市场更关注毛利、成本和后续指引；该标的只适合放在风险与压力观察，不适合写入重点多头推荐。

Cerebras (CBRS) 财报后重挫，AI硬件进入高预期筛选
Cerebras收入增长和指引并未阻止股价盘前下跌约15%-19%，反映亏损、估值和近期涨幅压力；AI链不再是凡利好皆上涨，必须优先看价格反馈。
光通信
Coherent (COHR) 与光通信链出现卖事实压力
Barron's报道Coherent强财报后仍跌约4%-7%，原因是相对Lumentum此前强反馈不够惊艳；这提示光通信和互连链今晚需要AMAT订单/指引继续确认。
媒体
Netflix (NFLX) 因Pershing Square持仓披露盘前上涨约2%
AP报道Netflix盘前上涨约2%，因Pershing Square披露重要持仓；相较多数高估值科技的财报压力，NFLX属于价格反馈更健康的成长权重。
财报
Applied Materials (AMAT) 今晚盘后披露，是半导体设备核心验证
MarketWatch、Kiplinger、TipRanks、Nasdaq相关日历均把AMAT列为8月13日盘后/收盘后财报重点，市场关注约3.40美元EPS、约90亿美元收入以及AI驱动DRAM、逻辑和设备订单指引。

盘前结论

PPI低于预期给指数提供温和托底，今天开盘更像“宏观缓和后的窄幅修复”。但纳指100未明显领涨，说明科技股已经从通胀交易切回财报质量和价格反馈筛选。

Cisco、Cerebras、Coherent的共同信号是：即使收入或订单不错，只要毛利、亏损、估值或指引不够强，市场也会卖事实。因此多头优先放在有盘前正反馈或能承接AI资本开支叙事的标的。

今晚AMAT是半导体设备链最重要的盘后验证；若订单和指引强，SMH可继续托住AI硬件，若不及预期，今天的科技修复会更偏短线。

触发因素：若开盘后能强于纳指并守住盘前涨幅，可作为成长权重中相对独立的资金承接点。

触发因素：若SMH强于纳指、AMAT盘前不继续走弱且AI硬件赢家守住缺口，NVDA可吸收配置资金。

风险点：若Cisco、Cerebras、Coherent的负反馈扩散，市场会质疑AI链估值和毛利，NVDA也会同步承压。

触发因素：若开盘成交放大且不被小盘成长整体拖累，可作为高beta科技的事件观察。

风险点：市值和流动性相对小，若大盘风险偏好降温，波动会显著放大。

硬件承接

推荐理由：盘前报道显示GRMN上涨超过6%，在消费和科技硬件之间提供比亏损AI股更稳的价格反馈。

触发因素：若开盘维持强势并伴随成交，说明资金愿意选择盈利硬件和高质量消费科技。

风险点：若消费数据或美元因素压制海外收入预期，硬件消费属性会削弱科技弹性。

事件驱动AMAT盘后财报验证晶圆设备、AI DRAM、逻辑投资和中国区订单；NFLX持仓披露带来资金事件。
压力方向Cisco、Cerebras、Coherent、StubHub代表的高预期财报股；无盈利AI、小盘成长和成本压力公司。
验证信号纳指能否重新强于标普、SMH是否守住、CSCO/CBRS是否止跌、AMAT盘前与盘后指引质量。

逻辑链

PPI低于预期缓和利率压力，给指数提供温和正向开盘条件。
纳指没有明显领涨，说明资金没有无差别追科技，而是在按财报质量、毛利和指引重新定价。
CSCO、CBRS、COHR的盘前负反馈要求把“好新闻但大跌”的公司放入风险，不写成多头推荐。
若NFLX、NVDA、ONDS、GRMN等正反馈标的守住开盘承接，市场可延续选择性科技修复；否则转为防御和现金流偏好。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正、行业景气和盘前价格反馈的判断，不是事实承诺。

中高概率Applied Materials (AMAT)：Kiplinger、TipRanks、MarketWatch和Nasdaq相关日历均显示8月13日盘后/收盘后披露，市场预期约3.40美元EPS、约90亿美元收入；AI驱动DRAM、先进逻辑和设备需求仍强，历史上公司也多次小幅beat，因此beat概率中等偏高。
主要分歧Applied Materials (AMAT)：盘中/盘前价格并非单边强势，且半导体设备估值已反映AI资本开支韧性；如果中国区订单、毛利或下一季收入指引保守，即便EPS beat，盘后股价也可能承压。
样本不足已检查MarketWatch、Kiplinger、TipRanks、Nasdaq相关日历、StockTi和TheStreet Pro摘要；今晚另有Workhorse (WKHS)、StoneCo (STNE)、Tapestry (TPR)、StubHub (STUB)等，但不属于核心科技公司样本，因此不把它们纳入科技beat分层。

风险雷达

高预期财报继续被卖

CSCO、CBRS、COHR若开盘后继续下行，会压制AI硬件和光通信估值。

利率二次反弹

PPI利好若被美联储鹰派讲话或30年期美债拍卖抵消，成长股会重新承压。

AMAT盘后指引风险

AMAT即便EPS超预期，若订单、毛利或AI相关收入指引不够强，半导体设备链可能盘后回落。

油价风险回摆

WTI暂时回落有利于通胀预期，但中东航运消息若反复，能源和通胀交易会重新压制消费与成长。

entries.html_en:
Major News
Macro
July PPI was unchanged month on month, below market expectations
Public reports showed July final-demand PPI unchanged from June and up about 4.7% year on year, below expectations and down sharply from June's 5.5%; core PPI rose about 0.2% month on month, giving the Fed more time to assess data before September.
Labor
Initial jobless claims near 209,000 did not break risk appetite
Investors.com reported initial jobless claims around 209,000, above forecasts but not enough to signal rapid labor deterioration; the PPI and claims mix supports a moderate open rather than panic defense.
Indexes
Futures are slightly firmer, with Nasdaq 100 lagging Dow and S&P 500
Premarket reports showed Dow futures around +0.2%, S&P 500 futures around +0.1%, and Nasdaq 100 futures slightly softer; the inflation relief is being partly offset by divergent technology earnings reactions.
Rates
The 10-year Treasury near 4.66%-4.68% still caps growth valuations
After PPI, the 10-year Treasury eased into roughly the 4.66%-4.68% area, but the absolute level remains high; it can support AI hardware stabilization while still constraining unprofitable software and small-cap growth.
Commodities
Oil and gold slipped, temporarily easing inflation pressure
AP, Investopedia and Barron's premarket reports all noted lower crude, with WTI around $81.3-$81.5 and Brent down nearly 2%; gold also softened, reducing the intraday inflation tail while not removing Middle East risk.
Earnings
Cisco (CSCO) fell about 6%-7% after a beat, so it is not a long recommendation
Cisco beat revenue and profit expectations, and AI hyperscaler orders remain supportive, but the stock fell about 6%-7% premarket as investors focused on margins, costs and forward guidance; it belongs in risk and pressure watch, not the focus-stock long list.
AI
Cerebras (CBRS) plunged after earnings, showing a higher bar for AI hardware
Cerebras revenue growth and guidance did not stop a roughly 15%-19% premarket drop, reflecting loss, valuation and recent-rally pressure; AI names no longer rise on every positive headline, so price feedback must come first.
Optics
Coherent (COHR) and optical links showed sell-the-news pressure
Barron's reported Coherent down roughly 4%-7% despite strong earnings because the result looked less impressive against Lumentum's earlier strength; optics and interconnects now need AMAT orders and guidance to keep confirming demand.
Media
Netflix (NFLX) rose about 2% after Pershing Square disclosed a position
AP reported Netflix up about 2% premarket after Pershing Square disclosed a significant stake; compared with earnings pressure in many high-multiple technology names, NFLX has healthier price feedback.
Earnings
Applied Materials (AMAT) reports after the close and is the key semiconductor-equipment test
MarketWatch, Kiplinger, TipRanks and Nasdaq-related calendars list AMAT as an August 13 after-close earnings focus, with investors watching roughly $3.40 EPS, about $9.0 billion revenue, and guidance for AI-driven DRAM, logic and equipment orders.

Pre-Market View

Softer-than-expected PPI gives indexes a mild cushion, so the open looks like a narrow macro-relief repair.But Nasdaq 100 is not clearly leading, meaning technology has shifted from an inflation trade back to earnings quality and price-feedback screening.

Cisco, Cerebras and Coherent carry the same message: even when revenue or orders are decent, the market can sell the news if margins, losses, valuation or guidance are not strong enough.Long exposure should therefore favor names with positive premarket feedback or credible support from AI capex.

Tonight AMAT is the most important after-close semiconductor-equipment test; strong orders and guidance can support SMH and AI hardware, while disappointment would make today's tech repair look more short-term.

Focus Stocks

Netflix
NFLX
Capital signal

Rationale: The stock rose about 2% premarket, giving it positive feedback during a split technology tape, while Pershing Square's stake disclosure adds institutional attention.

Trigger: If NFLX opens stronger than the Nasdaq and holds the premarket gain, it can act as a relatively independent large-cap growth support point.

Risk: Valuation is still not cheap; if the market weakens or streaming subscription and ad expectations are reassessed, the gain can fade.

NVIDIA
NVDA
AI capex anchor

Rationale: AI cloud, servers, optical interconnects and tonight's AMAT equipment test all point to resilient capex, leaving NVDA as the central upstream order and sentiment anchor.

Trigger: If SMH outperforms the Nasdaq, AMAT does not keep weakening premarket, and AI hardware winners hold their gaps, NVDA can absorb allocation flow.

Risk: If negative feedback from Cisco, Cerebras and Coherent spreads, the market will question AI-chain valuation and margins, weighing on NVDA too.

Ondas Holdings
ONDS
Premarket strength

Rationale: Barron's premarket table cited ONDS up more than 6%, making it one of the clearer small/mid technology and industrial-automation strength names today.

Trigger: If opening volume expands and small-cap growth does not drag it down, ONDS can remain an event-driven high-beta technology watch.

Risk: Market cap and liquidity are relatively small; if risk appetite cools, volatility can expand sharply.

Garmin
GRMN
Hardware support

Rationale: Premarket reports showed GRMN up more than 6%, offering better price feedback between consumer and technology hardware than loss-making AI names.

Trigger: If it keeps strength after the open with volume, capital is choosing profitable hardware and higher-quality consumer technology.

Risk: Consumer data or dollar pressure could hit overseas revenue expectations, reducing its technology beta.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength to WatchProfitable technology hardware, AI capex anchors, streaming large caps, selected industrial automation and semiconductor equipment.
Event-DrivenAMAT's after-close report tests wafer equipment, AI DRAM, logic investment and China orders; NFLX has a position-disclosure catalyst.
PressureHigh-expectation earnings names represented by Cisco, Cerebras, Coherent and StubHub; unprofitable AI, small-cap growth and cost-pressure companies.
SignalsWhether Nasdaq regains leadership versus the S&P 500, whether SMH holds, whether CSCO/CBRS stabilize, and AMAT's premarket tone plus after-close guidance.

Logic Chain

Softer-than-expected PPI eases rate pressure and gives indexes mildly positive opening conditions.
Nasdaq is not clearly leading, so capital is not chasing all technology; it is repricing based on earnings quality, margins and guidance.
CSCO, CBRS and COHR premarket weakness means companies with good news but sharp declines belong in risk, not long recommendations.
If positive-feedback names such as NFLX, NVDA, ONDS and GRMN hold opening support, selective technology repair can continue; otherwise leadership shifts toward defense and cash flow.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

The following is a judgment based on consensus expectations, historical surprise, recent guidance, sell-side revisions, industry conditions and premarket price feedback, not a factual promise.

Medium-High ProbabilityApplied Materials (AMAT): Kiplinger, TipRanks, MarketWatch and Nasdaq-related calendars list an August 13 after-close report, with expectations around $3.40 EPS and roughly $9.0 billion revenue; AI-driven DRAM, advanced logic and equipment demand remain strong, and the company has a history of modest beats, so beat probability looks medium-high.
Main DebateApplied Materials (AMAT): The stock is not showing one-way premarket or intraday strength, and semiconductor-equipment valuation already reflects AI capex resilience; if China orders, margins or next-quarter revenue guidance are conservative, even an EPS beat could still pressure after-hours price action.
Limited SampleChecked MarketWatch, Kiplinger, TipRanks, Nasdaq-related calendars, StockTi and TheStreet Pro summaries; Workhorse (WKHS), StoneCo (STNE), Tapestry (TPR), StubHub (STUB) and others are also on tonight's slate, but they are not core technology samples, so they are excluded from technology beat tiers.

Risk Radar

High-expectation earnings keep selling off

If CSCO, CBRS and COHR keep falling after the open, AI hardware and optical-link valuations will be pressured.

Second rate rebound

If PPI relief is offset by hawkish Fed remarks or the 30-year Treasury auction, growth stocks will come under pressure again.

AMAT guidance risk

Even if AMAT beats EPS, weak orders, margins or AI-related revenue guidance could pull semiconductor equipment lower after the close.

Oil risk swings back

WTI's pullback helps inflation expectations, but renewed Middle East shipping headlines would again pressure consumer and growth trades.
